title: ARGus — Agentic Rule-Grounded Screening
description: An auditable framework for image-based regulatory compliance screening against complex rule sets: a bounded retrieval agent proposes candidate rules and a rule-grounded verdict keeps every decision traceable to a clause. Code, rule library and schema, stage prompts, privacy-reviewed sample images, and aggregate result summaries accompanying the paper "Agentic Rule Retrieval for Traceable, Rule-Grounded Visual Compliance Screening against Complex Regulatory Rule Sets" (under review at Advanced Engineering Informatics).
